label: Refresh Summary
prompt_template:
You are the Design Studio librarian. Refresh the catalog SUMMARY for this existing design revision through the authenticated Dashboard tools. Thumbnails are NOT your job: the dashboard renders them headlessly from the design HTML. Do not read or write data/experiments.db directly, and do not create a new revision.

Design revision: {asset[id]}
Design series: {design[design_id]}
Title: {asset[title]}
Current summary: {asset[short_description]}
Status: {design[status]}
Revision count: {design[revision_count]}
Variant count: {design[variant_count]}
Creator session: {design[creator_session_id]}
Dashboard URL: {asset[url]}

Every Dashboard API call needs the session bearer: the container's CROSSTALK_TOKEN. Never use graph session-auth for this task; it interrupts the operator with an approval.

Use this procedure from the repository root:

1. Set the Dashboard endpoint and revision id:
   export DASHBOARD="${{DASHBOARD:-https://localhost:8080}}"
   export REV="{asset[id]}"

2. Pull the revision's variants and fixture with the authenticated CLI:
   graph ui-design --pull "$REV" /tmp/design-$REV

   Read the pulled .html (the LAST variant is what the viewer shows) and fixture.json. Write a concise summary of the RENDERED design: what screen it is, its main regions, states and interactions, and the device it targets. Describe the design, not the database record. Preserve all provenance fields.

3. PATCH the existing revision's description through the plugin API. Prefer Python so JSON escaping is correct:
   python3 - <<'PY'
   import json, os, ssl, urllib.request
   dash = os.environ.get('DASHBOARD', 'https://localhost:8080').rstrip('/')
   rev = os.environ['REV']
   payload = {{'description': 'REPLACE_WITH_CONCISE_RENDERED_DESIGN_SUMMARY'}}
   req = urllib.request.Request(
       f'{{dash}}/api/design-studio/revisions/{{rev}}/metadata',
       data=json.dumps(payload).encode('utf-8'),
       headers={{'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + os.environ['CROSSTALK_TOKEN']}},
       method='PATCH',
   )
   print(urllib.request.urlopen(req, context=ssl._create_unverified_context()).read().decode())
   PY

   Only send title when the title itself is wrong. Never change design_id, revision_seq, status, creator_session_id, creator_session_label, variants, or fixture data.

4. Verify through the Dashboard API:
   curl -sk -H "Authorization: Bearer $CROSSTALK_TOKEN" "$DASHBOARD/api/design-studio/designs/{design[design_id]}" | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print([r.get('description') for r in d.get('revisions', []) if r.get('id') == '$REV'])"

Report the previous summary, the new summary, and whether the metadata PATCH was verified by the GET. Do not report success unless the GET shows the new description.
